summary: The table compares the performance of various parsers based on their training methods and their F1 scores on the WSJ 23 dataset. It includes parsers such as those by Vinyals & Kaiser, Petrov, Zhu, Dyer, and others, with training methods categorized as WSJ only discriminative, semi-supervised, multi-task, and generative. The F1 scores range from 88.3 to 93.3, with the highest scores achieved by Dyer et al. (2016) using a generative approach and Luong et al. (2015) with a multi-task approach. The table highlights the effectiveness of different training strategies on parser performance.
